decisions.decision: The library is closed until Friday March 27th; staff continue reporting for regular hours.
decisions.quote: the library will be closed until friday march 27th. staff will still be reporting for regular hours.

decisions.decision: Returned books will be quarantined for a week, and quarantined books will not accrue fines, unless more specific info on surface-contact risk is received.
decisions.quote: muir said that they will quarantine returned books for a week unless we receive more specific info about the risks from surface contact.

decisions.decision: The library will have one additional cleaning per week, for three cleanings per week in total.
decisions.quote: there will be one addit ional cleaning per week for a total of three cleanings per week.
